title: Fill a missing mapping without changing configured agents

rubric.text: The response uses the existing binding and adds only the missing Low priority option ID from the supplied live read, without regenerating the configuration
The response retains the already configured Agent Setup and user model pin, and leaves the trusted reference and other mappings unchanged
The response treats this as a mapping addition for an adopted schema, reports ready-to-commit after validation, and does not run migration or mutate Project state
